name: Calendar
description: A simple shared calendar for a space. Editors add events on a given day or set them to repeat weekly (for example every Mon/Wed/Fri at 3pm) until an end date or forever, each with an optional time, length, colour, link and note; viewers and anonymous visitors get a clean read-only view. Switch between a month grid and a week view with events laid out by time of day. Timed events are authored in your own time zone and shown in each viewer's local time. Recurring events can be deleted for one day, from a day onward, or entirely, and an event's link opens in a new tab. The view adapts to its size, down to a compact upcoming-events agenda at about 200×200. The calendar is the space's table calendar.table.jsonl, one row per event, so it syncs with the space and opens in any table tool.
